purpose: Prestage the exact-content, zero-retry Wave2 model acquisition controls and retain both raw official immutable-revision tree responses without downloading model payloads.

transfer.ordinary_put_exception: Permitted only for this exact 13375-byte control-and-metadata archive; resumable SFTP remains mandatory for large payloads.

validation: verify remote archive bytes and SHA-256 before extraction
reject every member other than the exact six regular files and three directories
extract only into the fresh frozen extraction root
verify all six extracted file hashes and the two raw official API response byte counts
do not execute the downloader before Wave1 terminal acceptance and service release
resource_noninterference: Only a 13375-byte package is transferred and hashed; no model payload, dependency, API inference, pg0, or GPU access occurs.
failure: Any collision, interruption, size mismatch, hash mismatch, unsafe member, extraction failure, or file mismatch rejects the package and preserves received artifacts.
prohibited: starting either 8.8GB or 16.3GB model download while Wave1 is active
editing an extracted manifest, metadata response, or script
using the control package as model or numeric evidence
deleting any source, result, model, dataset, log, manifest, archive, or partial
